metadata.title: When you get 1 kill and suddenly think you’re the whole VALORANT squad
metadata.description:
Wait, I got a kill? Didn’t see that coming.
Watch me pretend I carried when it was pure accident.
Valorant logic: making no sense since forever.
Click if you ever got lucky and flexed anyway!

Tap if luck once made you feel like the MVP!
